title: Eurymachus: the bargain refused, the charge, the arrow; Amphinomus and the spear

events: "Eurymachus blames Antinous and offers repayment many times over if Odysseus spares them."
"Eurymachus, if you gave me all your fathers' wealth, my hands would not stop. Fight or run..."
"Eurymachus rallies the suitors to rush the archer beneath raised tables."
"Amphinomus charges and Telemachus kills him with a spear."
